purpose: Persona copy. Accounts and named people are filled in by code from the profile, historical_contacts.json and the CRM. The model may rewrite cares_about and message_angle when XAI_API_KEY is set.

personas.title_patterns: Head of Master Data, MDG Program Lead, Leiter Stammdaten, S/4 program owner, Head of ERP / SAP
personas.department: Master data, IT architecture, or the S/4 transformation office
personas.cares_about: A governed golden record, a rollout that survives cutover, and business rules and mass-change processes the plants can reuse.
personas.message_angle: Lead with the program outcome already delivered for a similar account: SAP MDG architecture, business rules, and replication into S/4. Name the won account in the same sector. Skip a generic digital-transformation opening.

personas.title_patterns: Internal MDG lead, master-data team lead, project manager who sponsors the external architect; master-data stewards and MDG developers who live with the result
personas.department: Master-data team, MDG development team, or project delivery
personas.cares_about: A rule set the team can extend, search and duplicate check that return the right record, fewer manual steps in the change request, and a clean handover.
personas.message_angle: Talk about the daily record and the handover, not the strategy: duplicate check, derivation, replication errors, and a framework the team keeps after the consultant leaves.

personas.title_patterns: Account manager, recruiter, or delivery manager at an SAP staffing or consulting firm
personas.cares_about: A consultant who fills an open SAP MDG seat fast, is available on the stated dates, and gets extended by the end customer.
personas.message_angle: Send availability, day rate, and the last three MDG engagements with dates. Name end customers the agency already serves when the profile shows them.
